llm.summary: This is a disclosed Chinese K12 chemistry lesson-planning skill with scoped classroom-data use and no executable code or hidden install behavior.

dimensions.detail: The skill is intentionally scoped to Mainland China Chinese K12 curriculum and safety-channel defaults, and the shared conventions explicitly say other regions need localization before student-facing use.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package contains Markdown and JSON reference/schema files only; no executable files, dependency installation, remote retrieval, or command execution behavior was found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Instructions define clear boundaries: no full lab procedures, no exam blueprint or paper analysis, teacher review before use, crisis referral handling, and minimized student identifiers.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: It references platform memory and file capabilities for class records, but write access is limited to teacher-confirmed lessonPlans and includes user controls for view, correction, deletion, pause, sharing, and export.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The artifacts consistently support chemistry lesson-plan drafting, unit compression, high-school transition lessons, safety triage for lab placement, and teacher-reviewed outputs.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install this for Chinese K12 chemistry lesson-planning workflows where teacher review is expected. Before using it outside Mainland China or with real student records, localize curriculum, emergency channels, and data-consent rules, and keep using aliases or seat numbers instead of real student names.
llm.findings:
[SDI-1] expected: The AI item-check file is referenced because the lesson planner may generate questions or materials inside a lesson draft; the main skill still excludes formal assessment design and requires teacher verification before use.
[SQP-3] expected: Chinese-language schemas, crisis text, and conventions are consistent with the stated Mainland China Chinese K12 deployment profile rather than hidden locale coercion; users outside that context should localize before use.
